description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and related components for the Orleans system's activation repartitioning, including system target interface, edge and vertex representations, candidate vertices for migration, and exchange request/response classes.

classes.name: Edge
classes.description: Represents a communication edge between a source and target vertex, with methods for equality, hashing, flipping, and string representation.

classes.name: EdgeVertex
classes.description: Represents one side of an edge, including grain ID, silo address, and migratability status.

classes.name: CandidateVertex
classes.description: Represents a candidate grain for transfer, including its transfer score and connected vertices.

classes.name: CandidateConnectedVertex
classes.description: Represents a connected vertex with a transfer score, used within CandidateVertex.

classes.name: AcceptExchangeRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates a request to accept a grain exchange, including sender silo, exchange set, and activation count snapshot.

classes.name: AcceptExchangeResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to an exchange request, including response type and involved grain IDs.

methods.name: GetReference
methods.description: Static method to obtain a reference to the activation repartitioner system target for a specific silo.
